text: Ask whether one article can end up written by two different models. If you buy an AI writing tool, ask whether switching models is ever used to get around a model's refusal. Ask what the article's status shows while it waits for a model to answer. When a vendor announces a reliability feature, ask how it can be switched off and what it was tested against. Ask whether you can see which models are lined up for your content, and in what order.
